entities.summary: Jennifer Semakula Musisi is a Ugandan lawyer, public administrator, and academic. She gained prominence as the first Executive Director of the Kampala Capital City Authority (KCCA) from 2011 to 2018, where she spearheaded significant transformations in the Ugandan capital. Following her tenure at KCCA, she became the first City Leader in Residence at the Bloomberg Harvard City Leadership Initiative.
